title: A WO WordPress build takes the demo kit off: no empty blog, RESERVE leads to contact, demo dropdowns and sample pages go, the name stands in for the picture logo
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/brief-wp-wo-leftovers.test.mjs vendor/tracy/tracy-website-opportunities/test/domain-page-plan.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: demoKitOff on the JA Restaurant 1.0.1 menu cuts the Explore/Themes dropdowns whose links repeat other links or lead to unpublished pages, keeps the restaurant's links, and gives the Reservation dropdown (no URL or '#') its contact child's URL.
A link by page id and a custom link to the same path are one destination; an absolute link to another host is never a page of this site, also when the site host is unknown.
woNameAsLogo clears site_logo only when every header/footer logo block prints the site name; a failed read leaves it alone.
The WO page plan does not keep a blog with no post of the business, or whose posts all went to other pages.
evidence: Dev WO build of a JA Restaurant WP site (22/10/2026): demo QA gate failed after three hand-off rounds (~1.95M tokens) on a demo blog, a RESERVE submenu with no URL, demo dropdowns and the template's picture logo.
fence: The WO sweep's demo-kit pass and the WO page plan's blog row

tests: an opportunity's menu loses the demo kit's dropdowns once their own pages are gone, and keeps the restaurant's
a reservation dropdown that is only a label leads to the contact page it holds
a reservation dropdown with a placeholder address takes the contact page address instead of keeping "#"
a link by page id and a link by address lead to one place, and an address on another site is not this one
when the site host is not known, an absolute link to another host is never the home page, and its dropdown stays
the name stands in for the logo only where every logo spot of the header and footer prints it
a header or footer that could not be read leaves the logo alone; only a part the site does not have is left out
a blog with no post of the restaurant is taken off with its reason; a dated or recurring post is no post of the blog
a blog whose only posts went to other pages is taken off, and the kept list agrees with the row
